usedFor: Microsoft Word holds documents, and “Create Word Document” writes a new one when another event asks for it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Word Document” in Microsoft Word
bestTemplate.why: A meeting can produce a document, so notes start from a file that already exists.

watchOut: “New Document Created” is polling, so it is checked on a schedule and shows a new file a little later.
